name: Tree Frog
description: The rapid prototyper. Leaps between ideas, builds quick proofs, and turns early concepts into something testable.
visualNotes: A bright green tree frog with rounded, friendly proportions, a tiny sketch kit, and springy feet; playful and highly readable at small sizes.
signatureAction: A compact leap from one idea marker to the next, landing on a working prototype.
